title: SLF001 false positives in __new__
body:
### Summary

If constructor magic method `__new__` is used also to set some private attributes of the new object, it is reported by ruff as violation of rule SLF001.

Example:
using  `ruff check ./test.py --select SLF`
on test.py:
```python
class A:
    def __new__(cls):
        obj = object().__new__(cls)
        obj.public_attr = 'foo'
        obj._private_attr = 'bar'
```
returns:
```
SLF001 Private member accessed: `_private_attr`
 --> src/trx5g/test.py:8:9
  |
6 |         obj = object().__new__(cls)
7 |         obj.public_attr = 'foo'
8 |         obj._private_attr = 'bar'
  |         
```

### Version

0.16.2
